# WAM convention checks

These checks run in the `conventions` job of `.github/workflows/linting.yml` on every module PR. Each check enforces a rule of the [WAM standard](https://github.com/CloudNationHQ/wam-support/blob/main/CLAUDE.md).

| ID | Rule | Severity | Check |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WAM001 | 7 | error | no `any` in variable types |
| WAM002 | 9 | error | for_each only, never count |
| WAM003 | 7 | error | no optional(bool, true) |
| WAM004 | 7, 8 | warning | no try() defaulting in main.tf |
| WAM005 | 3 | error | pessimistic (~>) version constraints |
| WAM006 | 17 | error | no user-assigned identity inside a module |
| WAM007 | 4 | error | azapi needs an explaining comment |
| WAM008 | 12 | error | lifecycle needs an explaining comment |
| WAM009 | 12 | error | depends_on needs an explaining comment |
| WAM010 | 26 | error | moved blocks only in moved_vX_to_vY.tf |
| WAM011 | 1, 10 | warning | sentinel key is "this", not "default" |
| WAM012 | 5 | error | no config, instance, environment or naming variable |
| WAM013 | 6 | error | only location, resource_group_name and tags have defaults |
| WAM014 | 7 | error | no default on security flags |

## Ignoring a finding

Put `# wam-lint-ignore WAM002 <reason>` on the line of the finding or on the line above it. Several IDs can be separated by commas. The reason is mandatory; an ignore without a reason or with an unknown ID is reported as WAM000.

## Warning and enforce mode

Repos listed in `lint/conventions-enforced.txt` fail on error findings. All other repos get the findings as warnings only.
